description:
Splits the monolithic `CommandExecutor` public surface into per-family facades and moves every storage call, repository bootstrap, search, claim and foreground-serve step the CLI makes on its own behind the executor or `commands/`.

## Background

`CommandExecutor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`) exposes about 195 methods in 28 `impl` blocks across 25 files, so any consumer that needs one family (the HTTP server needs issues, documents, gates and validation) accepts the whole surface, including session and cache internals and a `pub config_manager` field. Separately, `crates/jit/src/main.rs` bypasses the executor: `run()` constructs `JsonFileStorage`, opens mutation sessions and calls `storage.validate()`; issue arms call `storage.resolve_issue_id` and `storage.load_issue` after each mutation; `Commands::Search` calls `jit::search::search`; claim and recover arms call `commands::claim` free functions with `&storage`; and foreground `jit serve` spawns and waits on the server inline and calls `std::process::exit`.

On main, `run()` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` parses the arguments and calls `dispatch()` in `main.rs`, which holds the command match; the arms and inline code this issue places in `run()` live in `dispatch()`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each command family is reachable through a facade returned by a `CommandExecutor` accessor (for example `issues()` returning `IssueOps<'_, S>`), and the executor's public surface is limited to its constructors and those accessors.
- [hard] REQ-02: The CLI command path makes no direct `IssueStore` or `JsonFileStorage` call: repository opening, issue mutations, template application, search, claims and foreground serve go through library functions that return what the CLI reports.
- [hard] REQ-03: The CLI's human output, JSON output and exit codes are unchanged by this restructuring, and the existing Rust suites pass with no assertion weakened.

## Notes

- 0f8efc37 later adopts the repository bootstrap for the server and replaces what the executor search entry point computes.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1, D-11); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Narrow executor surface and storage-free CLI entry
